notes.premium_amount: Uses 'Cantidad adeudada' ($260.00, after the -$225 tax credit and +$35 adjustment), not 'Prima bruta mensual' ($450.00) - consistent with the other two documents in this set. LLM's value (450.00) is the gross premium, not the amount actually due.
notes.payment_status: Not printed as a literal 'Paid' label like the other two documents, but 'Pagos aplicados -$260.00' exactly matches 'Cantidad adeudada $260.00' with a resulting 'Saldo actual $0.00' - fully paid.
